questions.question: Which command removes all rows from a table but usually keeps the table structure?

questions.question: Which isolation level can allow dirty reads?
questions.explanation: Read Uncommitted allows reading uncommitted data (dirty reads).

questions.question: A schedule where dirty reads are avoided (a transaction reads only committed values) is called:
questions.explanation: Cascadeless schedules allow reading only committed data, avoiding cascading rollbacks.

questions.question: Which OS technique allows execution of a process even if its full address space is not in main memory?
questions.explanation: Virtual memory/demand paging loads pages when needed.

questions.question: Which is a non-preemptive scheduling algorithm?

Fill: He succeeded ___ hard work.
Fill: She has lived in Surat ___ five years.
Fill: ___ apple a day keeps the doctor away.
Fill: Hardly had he spoken ___ everyone clapped.
Replace: He is capable to handle pressure.
Replace: She ordered for a coffee.
Main idea of the passage?

options.C: AI should replace all bankers immediately
options.D: AI helps fraud detection but needs explainability and human oversight

questions.explanation: Balances AI benefits with false positives, explainability, human review.
questions.context:
Directions (Q37–Q40): Read the passage.

Banks are adopting AI models to detect unusual payment patterns and flag possible fraud in near real time. While this improves security, models can produce false positives that annoy genuine customers. Explainability is important so that banks can justify automated decisions to regulators and customers. Human review remains necessary for borderline cases. Continuous training on fresh fraud patterns helps models stay effective against new attack techniques.

questions.question: What problem can AI models create for genuine customers?
Why is explainability important?

options.A: To justify automated decisions to regulators and customers
